title: Embedding Geometry Shapes LLM Routing: Tracing Failure Modes and Improving Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2610.19198v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: With the growing number of LLMs available, selecting which one to use for a prompt has become a key question. A large part of the routing literature relies on semantically embedding prompts into a vector space and then applying a lightweight classifier to the embedded representations. These methods perform robustly in-distribution but they struggle to generalize to unseen tasks. By studying the geometry of semantic embeddings, we trace a clear failure mode: features that determine the neighbors of unseen prompts are an unreliable proxy for LLM selection. We therefore replace the semantic embedding with the following map: we run a partial forward pass of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct on the prompt and use the hidden state of its last token at a deep layer as the representation. translated_title: 嵌入几何形态决定大语言模型路由：追踪失效模式并提升泛化能力
translated_abstract: 随着可用的大语言模型（LLM）数量不断增长，如何为给定提示选择合适的模型已成为一个关键问题。路由领域的许多研究依赖于将提示语义嵌入到向量空间中，然后对嵌入表示应用轻量级分类器。这些方法在分布内表现稳健，但难以泛化到未见过的任务。通过研究语义嵌入的几何结构，我们追踪到一个明确的失效模式：决定未见提示邻居的特征是LLM选择的不可靠代理。因此，我们用以下映射替换语义嵌入：对提示运行Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct的部分前向传播，并使用其在深层的最后一个token的隐藏状态作为表示。当对这种新表示应用kNN和其他简单分类器时，我们在泛化方面获得了明确的结果：在平均各种成本惩罚下，它们的性能……
tldr: 该论文揭示了语义嵌入的几何结构是LLM路由在未见任务上失效的根源，并提出用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct深层最后token的隐藏状态替代语义嵌入作为表示，从而显著提升路由方法对未见任务的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that the geometry of semantic embeddings is the root cause of LLM routing failures on unseen tasks, and proposes replacing semantic embeddings with the hidden state of the last token at a deep layer from a partial forward pass of Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, significantly improving routing generalization.
